reviewContext.userProblem: Phase 1 always plays the automatic slide transition. Authors need to choose per-slide transitions and per-shape entrance/exit/linked effects, with exactly Phase 1 behaviour when nothing is set.
requiredOutcomes: Per-shape Element.visual.animation and per-slide visual.animation.slide on one artwork-free presentation.slide resource element per page; both validate in IR documents and core commands, and round-trip through JSONL and Yjs.
Pure planner honours cut/fade/auto, duration, stagger, per-shape effects, delay, duration, order, mirrored effects backwards, slide N ownership; no settings gives the pinned Phase 1 plan.
Runner plays undraw, scale-in/out, slide-in/out, appear, disappear, swap and slide-fade; cancel leaves no stale layer.
Inspector Slide transition (every page, including empty) and Slide animation (single and multi-selection) sections; one undo step per edit; disabled when read-only.
No new Command kind; updateDocument unchanged; commands.ts changes limited to validation wiring.
nonGoals: Page fields or updatePage changes (hosted Worker rejects them)
Shape-type morphing, glyph-outline text, click-by-click builds, video export, LaTeX, timeline editor
constraints: Workers edit only their writePaths, progress file and evidence directory; no git state changes; no new dependencies; no any; no emojis.
Strict-index gate against target/strict-index/baseline.log (ccac2d3) must exit 0 for each plan's TypeScript writePaths.
mise run verify gets up to 3 attempts for deadline tests under load; deadlines are never relaxed.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Per-slide settings live in visual.animation.slide of one artwork-free presentation.slide resource element per page, not on Page.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The unchanged hosted Worker authoring parser whitelists updatePage.page fields (authoring.ts:167-172,197-200) and rejects new ones; createElement, replaceVisual and deleteElements with visual.animation were accepted in the Step 3 diagnostics (8909db, 051f24). Design 3.1 and 3.1.1.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Per-shape settings live in optional Element.visual.animation written with updateVisual/replaceVisual.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Same transport path as Phase 1 linkId; no new Command kind and updateDocument unchanged. Design 3.1.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Slide N owns the transition between N-1 and N in both directions; going backwards mirrors enter/exit effects (draw-on and grow to undraw, fade-in/fade-out, scale-in/scale-out, slide-in/slide-out).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Owner decision in the intake constraints; design section 2.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Absent settings use the Phase 1 timing constants unmultiplied and a stable ranking with key 0, pinned by a fixture test captured from the unmodified a9abe26 planner.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Guarantees identical Phase 1 plans; design 5.2 to 5.4. slide-transition.test.ts is not edited (git diff --exit-code guard in slt-04 and slt-07).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Inapplicable effects fall back to auto; the planner resolves mirrors and the runner only plays concrete kinds.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps the planner pure and JSON-serialisable and the runner simple; design 5.2 and 11.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Seven plans: two independent foundation plans (slt-01, slt-02), four wave-2 feature plans (slt-03 to slt-06), and one wiring plan (slt-07) that solely owns the shared registration files.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Intake planning rules: at most 2 waves before wiring, disjoint writePaths, maximised concurrency; accepted at Step 5 review.

intentionalTradeoffs: A dedicated carrier element instead of a Page field: older builds see an unknown element type (type.unknown warning, payload preserved).
Two carriers on one page (concurrent creation) resolve deterministically to the first in (index, id) order; the second is ignored.
Deleting the carrier by explicit id (CLI/API) resets the slide to defaults.
slt-03 and slt-04 exceed the ~150-line plan guideline because they carry pitfall detail.
Between slt-01 and slt-03 landing, io golden coverage is temporarily incomplete; slt-03 repairs it in wave 2.
mise run verify gets up to 3 attempts for deadline tests under load; deadlines are never relaxed.
supportedEdgeCases: Empty slides: the Slide transition controls create the carrier on a page with no artwork.
Deleting all artwork keeps slide settings; Select all excludes presentation.slide.
Duplicate page keeps the carrier; Copy shapes from page and planPaste drop it unless keepSlideCarrier is set.
Linked pairs whose paint order differs between pages rank by incoming paint order unless the owner sets order.
Instant kinds swap, appear and disappear have duration 0 and still honour delayMs.
Multi-selection edits apply to all selected elements as one undo step; read-only documents disable the controls.
Cancel mid-transition leaves no stale layer and restores markers.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Shape-type morphing, glyph-outline text writing, click-by-click builds, video export, LaTeX/math, timeline editor, document-level setting.
A future Worker that validates nested visual.animation keys.

acceptanceCriteria: All IR names pinned in slt-overview.md are exported from @nodetto/ir; Visual.animation is declared after linkId and ordered after linkId in keyOrder with nested animation/slide child orders.
validateElementAnimation reports value.enum, type.boolean, range.animation errors and field.unknown warnings at exact paths; presentation.slide is a registered resource type.
createElement, updateVisual and replaceVisual throw CommandError for invalid animation values without mutating the store, accept warning-only unknown keys, and undo restores exactly.
